about_the_game:
Purchase Destiny 2: Year of Prophecy Ultimate Edition Upgrade to experience two new campaigns, new destinations, gear, and much more. Purchase now to get access to both expansions (Destiny 2: The Edge of Fate and Destiny 2: Renegades coming December 2, 2025), plus 4x Rewards Pass access for Year of Prophecy, and access to the raid/epic raid and dungeon, all upon release.

Experience a full year of exploration and adventure with the Destiny 2: Year of Prophecy Ultimate Edition, featuring the start of a new saga in Destiny.

Your journey begins with a mysterious invitation. Uncover powerful new weapons and armor, master new abilities, and challenge yourself and your fireteam across two new destinations, and an all-new raid and dungeon. The Guardian’s future is now as a new saga begins, setting the stage for conflicts and revelations ahead.

In addition, the Year of Prophecy Ultimate Edition includes the Secret Stash (1x Exotic Cosmetic, 1x Exotic Cipher, 2x Ascendant Alloys, 3x Ascendant Shards, delivered with each seasonal release), the New Land Beyond Exotic Sniper Rifle ornament and catalyst, the Year of Prophecy Exotic Sparrow, the Dark Side Legends Bundle, and access to the Year of Prophecy Rewards Pass seasonal updates throughout the year.
